referenceText: A clear voice makes each word easy to hear. Take your time, finish each sound, and leave a short pause before the next word. The bright light fell across the quiet room.

qwen.instruction: A calm adult male voice in a comfortable lower register. Neutral American English, restrained and steady intonation, precise consonants, fully articulated word endings, and deliberate unhurried diction. Speak naturally and plainly, without breathiness, theatrical emphasis, or a singsong delivery.

voices.description: A mature American male voice with a natural warm baritone register. Calm, grounded and neutral, with restrained pitch variation. Clean dry studio recording, clear precise consonants, complete word endings and deliberate diction. Comfortable conversational volume and an unhurried pace. No rasp, vocal fry, breathiness or announcer performance.

voices.label: Clear instructor
voices.detail: A second synthetic design emphasizing clear pronunciation
voices.description: An adult male American English instructor with a clear natural middle-low register. Plain, patient and precise speech with crisp but natural consonants and distinct vowel contrasts. Steady restrained intonation and a slightly slower educational speaking pace. Clean close studio sound, without a dramatic bass voice, breathiness, vocal fry, excessive enthusiasm or singing.
